description: Source code for QuicReceiveControlStream class handling HTTP/3 control stream processing in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicReceiveControlStream
classes.description: Handles HTTP/3 control stream processing in QUIC, including frame validation, error handling, and session communication.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset events, reports error if reset occurs.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Processes incoming data frames, decodes frames, and manages flow control.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles decoder errors and reports stream errors.

methods.name: OnMaxPushIdFrame
methods.description: Handles MAX_PUSH_ID frame, validates frame type.

methods.name: OnGoAwayFrame
methods.description: Processes GOAWAY frames, notifies session.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrameStart
methods.description: Validates start of SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Processes SETTINGS frame and updates session.

methods.name: OnDataFrameStart
methods.description: Validates start of DATA frame.

methods.name: OnDataFramePayload
methods.description: Handles data frame payload, not implemented.

methods.name: OnDataFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of data frame, not implemented.

methods.name: OnHeadersFrameStart
methods.description: Validates start of HEADERS frame.

methods.name: OnHeadersFramePayload
methods.description: Handles headers frame payload, not implemented.

methods.name: OnHeadersFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of headers frame, not implemented.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateFrameStart
methods.description: Validates start of PRIORITY_UPDATE_REQUEST_STREAM frame.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateFrame
methods.description: Processes priority update frames and updates request stream priorities.

methods.name: OnAcceptChFrameStart
methods.description: Validates start of ACCEPT_CH frame.

methods.name: OnAcceptChFrame
methods.description: Processes ACCEPT_CH frames.

methods.name: OnWebTransportStreamFrameType
methods.description: Handles WebTransport stream frames, triggers bug if called.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrameStart
methods.description: Handles unknown frame types, validates frame type.

methods.name: OnUnknownFramePayload
methods.description: Ignores unknown frame payloads.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of unknown frames.

methods.name: ValidateFrameType
methods.description: Validates frame types for control stream, enforces sequence rules.
